Answer: C
Reason: Stage I sarcoidosis is classically defined by bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy (BHL), which is frequently accompanied by right paratracheal lymph node enlargement (the "1-2-3 sign"); the provided radiograph demonstrates prominent bilateral hila and a widened right paratracheal stripe consistent with this pattern. *(guided by t000004)*
